state.background: Plan45 Phase 3 B3c adds two focused Browser Mode implementation candidates: a CAGR calculation interaction for stable row p45-a-cagr-sheet-02 and a desktop nominal chart Escape-dismiss interaction for stable row p45-b-tooltip-dismiss-578-chromium-escape-dismiss. The fresh B3c plan reassessment explicitly requires the actual CagrPanel/useCagrState flow and the actual useChartTooltipController desktop Escape path through production chart handler props. The corresponding Playwright assertions remain unchanged until the ten-case migration gate, so these are green staged candidates rather than completed E2E transfers.
acceptanceCriteria: The CAGR test mounts actual CagrPanel and actual useCagrState with deterministic chart data, changes the selected start year to 2015, performs the actual calculation, and verifies the dialog remains visible before/after interaction, the result is visible, and the signed two-decimal result is -12.94%, covering P42-046–049. The result is derived from the fixture values, not mocked.
The CAGR test does not claim coverage of the production section/route trigger P42-040/-041, which remains in Playwright.

The Escape test mounts the actual nominal SpendingBarChart and actual useChartTooltipController configured with suppressed:false and isTouch:false; it passes tooltipProps and all five production handlers: onPointerDown, onPointerMove, onMouseMove, onPointerLeave, and onMouseLeave.

The Escape test asserts the real rendered bar is visible, performs browser pointer hover over that bar, confirms the actual tooltip is visible with nominal series 食料（名目） and value 123.00 before Escape, sends userEvent.keyboard('{Escape}'), and asserts the tooltip is removed from the DOM.
The Escape test does not directly set activeChartId, Tooltip active state, or Tooltip content. Its transfer scope is P42-577 only.

All other assertions in the combined Playwright tooltip-dismiss scenario remain there, including P42-575/-576 chart and bar setup, P42-578/-579 re-hover setup, P42-580 mouseleave behavior, P42-581–583 heading/bounds/outside-click behavior, plus route and coordinate guarantees.
Both B3c cases are recorded as green implementation candidates while their source E2E assertions remain untouched; no completed-transfer or full-row claim is made.
verification: Final focused Browser Mode command: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/home/shunki/.cache/ms-playwright XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/nextjstest-pnpm-cache pnpm exec vitest --config vitest.browser.config.ts run tests/browser-mode/CagrPanel.browser.test.tsx tests/browser-mode/SpendingBarChart-tooltip-dismiss.browser.test.tsx; result: 2 files passed, 2 tests passed, exit code 0, duration 5.03 seconds.

An earlier focused attempt failed because the responsive chart container measured 0x0 and the test used not.toBeVisible for a tooltip removed from the DOM; trace artifact copying also hit ENAMETOOLONG due to long test titles. The fixture now asserts a 1280x800 Browser Mode viewport, uses shorter titles, and uses the local Browser Mode not.toBeInTheDocument precedent for the removed tooltip.

The Escape test additionally asserts the actual bar visible and the expected nominal tooltip series/value before Escape, preventing an initially absent tooltip from satisfying the dismissal assertion. The final focused run passed after these changes.

Independent Oracle review confirmed the actual controller/handler path addresses P42-577 and recommended visible bar plus pre-Escape tooltip-content checks; those checks are present and the final focused run passes. No Playwright source assertions were removed and no E2E command was run.
knownConstraints: These Browser Mode cases verify component/hook interactions with deterministic fixtures, not production route triggering, route-fed data, chart-coordinate geometry, or outside-click integration.
The E2E source assertions remain intact pending the ten-case gate; these are staged candidates, not completed transfers.
The Escape case verifies the local desktop controller and event-handler path, while production viewport and route integration guarantees remain in Playwright.
state.outputRequirement: Select one criterion for this B3c implementation checkpoint. If not valid_as_defined, report a case-specific finding, affected file and Plan42/Plan45 requirement, observed evidence, and either a concrete fix or exact additional evidence needed; state remaining uncertainty explicitly, using none if resolved. Do not claim E2E source assertions have been migrated or recommend running E2E before all ten named Browser Mode cases pass.

implementation.instructions: Assess whether this specific B3c implementation checkpoint is valid as defined under the corrected plan, actual controller/handler requirements, retained assertion boundaries, and final focused Browser Mode result. Select exactly one criterion from the supplied set; give the case-specific required diagnosis if selecting a non-pass criterion.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The implementation and evidence satisfy the B3c component-level checkpoint within the corrected plan scope.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: Implemented behavior contradicts or fails an applicable requirement.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: Required prerequisite information is absent and prevents assessment.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: The implementation or evidence is too incomplete to assess the defined checkpoint.
criteria.implementation_issue: A concrete defect or unsupported behavior exists in the implementation.
criteria.scope_violation: The implementation exceeds or fails to respect the stated scope boundaries.
criteria.other: A material issue exists that does not fit the other criteria.
criteria.indeterminate: The available information does not support a reliable determination.
